summary: A six-track synth firmware forked from Hortator, with a monophonic synth or FX machine on each track, eight-knob pages and a step sequencer with parameter locks. Still in beta, tested on one unit.
features: Synth machines incl. SuperWave, SID, FM, drums; FX machines on any track
Resonant HP/LP filter, tape delay and three LFOs per track
Up to 64 steps per track, probability, ratchets, locks and parameter slide
330 factory sounds; FX tracks route via buses as insert or send
MIDI and clock over USB and TRS, MIDI learn
Expanded sound library replaces two of the three sample slots
